## Circulation note for a blank collection specimen

This covering note accompanies a blank collection form. It contains no completed recipient, contact or personal-document values. The table below illustrates the relationship between the entries required and the evidence to be retained; its words describe fields and tasks only.

| Field or task | Required check | Record to retain |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Recipient details | Obtain instructions before completion | Signed authority |
| Package count | Compare with the physical packages | Collection inventory |
| Delivery acknowledgement | Distinguish receipt from inspection | Signed receipt |
| Later correction | Identify the changed entry | Earlier and revised versions |

An empty field must not be filled with a sample name merely to demonstrate its width. A fictional account number or email value could later be mistaken for a completed instruction if the specimen were separated from this covering note.

The reviewer should inspect every copied page, including the reverse side of a page where an annotation is visible through the paper. A complete fax transmission does not prove that the source set included every enclosure.

The illustrative copying allowance is GBP 30. The proposed review date is 24 February 2027. Section 4.2, article 15 and schedule 3 are legal references. The terms attorney, witness and recipient identify capacities rather than people.

Please preserve the blank specimen with this note. No signature, personal address or financial destination is supplied in either document.
